title: SRIT India lists at 14% premium on NSE

timeline.title: SRIT India lists today on BSE, NSE
timeline.line: ₹218.4 cr IPO priced at ₹123–130; grey market hinted at ~36% premium
more: Issue ran Sept 28–30; allotment on Oct 1
GMP of ₹47 as of Oct 4 is informal and may not hold

timeline.title: SRIT India debuts after 116x subscription
timeline.line: ₹130 issue; grey market pointed to a 36–45% listing premium before debut
more: ₹218.4 cr IPO; lot size of 115 shares
GMP is informal and may not reflect the actual listing price

timeline.title: SRIT India lists at 14% premium on NSE
timeline.line: Opened at ₹148 on NSE vs ₹130 issue price; ₹139.80 on BSE, a 7.5% premium
more: Gain of ₹2,070 per 115-share lot at the NSE listing price
Debut came below grey-market hopes of a 36–45% premium
